title: S1 discovery boundary (researching-ba-problem-space output)
description: Boundary contract for the S1 discovery node (s1-discovery). Mirrors researching-ba-problem-space/schemas/output.json; permissive at the envelope (additionalProperties:true) so the handoff_to_intake block and future fields pass. The recommendation enum drives the S1 human gate (proceed_when: proceed).

handoff_to_intake.description: Typed handoff merged into the brief node's input.discovery. Present only when recommendation == proceed.
